nodes.label: Gate 10 Evidence (CDC Pipeline Verified)
nodes.description: Gate 10 substantially closed. Live Docker CDC pipeline verified end to end: POST /api/ingestion/events → raw_sensor_events + raw_event_outboxes(pending) → Debezium binlog → iot-cdc.* → outbox-cdc-consumer → iot.raw-events → raw-consumer normalized → 2 sensor_readings created → domain_event_outboxes → domain:consume delivered (2/2, 0 pending). Two real bugs found and fixed: Debezium config mount path (v3.5 reads /debezium/config/), Redis stream key-prefix mismatch (publishers used Laravel facade prefix, consumers used raw commands). Backend: 303 tests, 0 failed, 1170 assertions (isolated SQLite + Redis 6399). Frontend: 182 tests, 0 failures; build green; no-polling gate PASS; Playwright 53/53 clean. Observability: EventPipelineMetricsService::snapshot() with stream/consumer/outbox counters. Outstanding: scripted CDC fault injection A-E, formal network-quiet capture, remote CI execution.
nodes.rationale: The most critical evidence document. Proves the CDC pipeline works end to end on the live Docker stack, documents the two real bugs found and fixed, and provides the test evidence for Gate 10 closure.
